  function openHubSpotChat() {
    if (isHubSpotReady()) {
      window.HubSpotConversations.widget.open();
      return;
    }
    
    let attempts = 0;
    const maxAttempts = 20;
    const interval = setInterval(function() {
      attempts++;
      
      if (isHubSpotReady()) {
        window.HubSpotConversations.widget.open();
        clearInterval(interval);
      } else if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
        console.warn('The HubSpot chat widget failed to load after 10 seconds');
        clearInterval(interval);
      }
    }, 500);
  }

  if(wrapper){
    wrapper.addEventListener("click", function(e){

      openHubSpotChat();
    });
  }

  var chatButton = document.querySelector('.elementor-button-link[href="#"]');
  if(chatButton){
    chatButton.addEventListener("click", function(e){
      e.preventDefault();
      openHubSpotChat();
    });
  }

<script type="rocketlazyloadscript">
(function () {
	var STEP_DEG      = 36;
	var TRANSITION_MS = 700;  // duration of each rotation step
	var PAUSE_MS      = 2000; // pause between steps

	// Start at 90° so icon[0] (base 0°) sits at the 3-o'clock active position
	var totalRot  = 90;
	var BASE_DEGS = [0, 36, 72, 108, 144, 180, 216, 252, 288, 324];
	var ACTIVE_POS = 90; // 3 o'clock = right side

	var integrations = [
		{ name: 'Salesforce',       desc: 'See in-app activity directly inside Salesforce',        logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/salesfoce-logo-userpilot-integration-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'HubSpot',          desc: 'Pull contact data to personalize onboarding flows',       logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/hubspot-logo-userpilot-integration-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'Segment',          desc: 'Sync data across every Segment-connected tool',             logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/segment-logo-userpilot-integration-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'Mixpanel',         desc: 'Push Userpilot events to Mixpanel for deeper insights', logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/mixpanel-logo-userpilot-integration-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'Zendesk',          desc: 'Embed Zendesk articles and chatbot inside your product',    logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/Zendesk-logo-userpilot-integrations-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'Intercom',         desc: 'Trigger Intercom messages based on in-app behavior',         logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/intercom-logo-userpilot-integration-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'Google Analytics', desc: 'Connect in-app experience data to your Google Analytics',     logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/ga-logo-userpilot-integration-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'Amplitude',        desc: 'Push Userpilot events to Amplitude for deeper insights',       logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/amplitude-logo-userpilot-integration-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'Webhooks',         desc: 'Send real-time Userpilot events to any third-party tool',         logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/webhooks-logo-userpilot-integration-1.svg' },
		{ name: 'REST API',         desc: 'Migrate historical data in, export Userpilot events out',      logo: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/webhooks-logo-userpilot-integration-1-1.svg' },
	];

	var ring      = document.getElementById('intRing');
	var icons     = document.querySelectorAll('#intRing .int-icon');
	var logoEl    = document.getElementById('intActiveLogo');
	var textEl    = document.getElementById('intActiveText');

	if (!ring) return;

	// Which icon index sits at ACTIVE_POS given current totalRot?
	function getActiveIdx() {
		var best = 0, minDist = Infinity;
		BASE_DEGS.forEach(function (d, i) {
			var eff  = (d + totalRot % 360 + 360) % 360;
			var dist = Math.min(Math.abs(eff - ACTIVE_POS), 360 - Math.abs(eff - ACTIVE_POS));
			if (dist < minDist) { minDist = dist; best = i; }
		});
		return best;
	}

	// Apply rotation transforms — pass animated=false for instant (no transition)
	function applyRotation(animated) {
		var dur = animated ? TRANSITION_MS + 'ms' : '0ms';
		ring.style.transition       = 'transform ' + dur + ' cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.10, 0.64, 1)';
		icons.forEach(function (icon) {
			icon.style.transition   = 'transform ' + dur + ' cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.10, 0.64, 1)';
		});
		ring.style.transform  = 'translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(' + totalRot + 'deg)';
		icons.forEach(function (icon, i) {
			icon.style.transform = 'translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(' + (-(totalRot + BASE_DEGS[i])) + 'deg)';
		});
	}

	// Update label for active integration
	function updateUI(idx, fade) {
		var int = integrations[idx];
		icons.forEach(function (el, i) { el.classList.toggle('is-active', i === idx); });
		if (!logoEl) return;
		if (fade) {
			logoEl.style.opacity = textEl.style.opacity = '0';
			setTimeout(function () {
				logoEl.src         = int.logo;
				logoEl.alt         = int.name;
				textEl.textContent = int.desc;
				logoEl.style.opacity = textEl.style.opacity = '1';
			}, 200);
		} else {
			logoEl.src         = int.logo;
			logoEl.alt         = int.name;
			textEl.textContent = int.desc;
		}
	}

	// Initialise without transition
	applyRotation(false);
	// Force layout flush so the instant transform is painted before transitions re-enable
	void ring.offsetWidth;
	updateUI(getActiveIdx(), false);

	// Cog-step: advance 60° then pause — only while section is visible
	var intTimer = null;
	function startIntTimer() {
		if (intTimer) return;
		intTimer = setInterval(function () {
			totalRot += STEP_DEG;
			applyRotation(true);
			setTimeout(function () { updateUI(getActiveIdx(), true); }, TRANSITION_MS / 2);
		}, TRANSITION_MS + PAUSE_MS);
	}
	function stopIntTimer() {
		if (intTimer) { clearInterval(intTimer); intTimer = null; }
	}

	if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
		new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
			entries[0].isIntersecting ? startIntTimer() : stopIntTimer();
		}, { threshold: 0 }).observe(ring);
	} else {
		startIntTimer();
	}
})();

		TABS_DATA.forEach(function (key) { setRingProgress(key, 0); });

		var activeMock = container.querySelector('.hero-video-mock[data-mock="' + name + '"]');
		if (activeMock && !activeMock.querySelector('.hero-video')) startImageTimer(name);
	}

	// ── When the active video ends, move on to the next tab — loops back to the first
	function goToNextTab(currentKey) {
		var idx = TABS_DATA.indexOf(currentKey);
		setActiveTab(TABS_DATA[(idx + 1) % TABS_DATA.length]);
	}

	setActiveTab(TABS_DATA[0]);

	// ── Wire each video's own progress ring + auto-advance on end
	mocks.forEach(function (m) {
		var key = m.dataset.mock;
		var v   = m.querySelector('.hero-video');
		if (!v) return;

		v.addEventListener('timeupdate', function () {
			if (!v.duration) return;
			setRingProgress(key, v.currentTime / v.duration);
		});

		v.addEventListener('ended', function () {
			goToNextTab(key);
		});
	});

	// ── Lazy-load: set src from data-src when the tabs enter the viewport
	var loaded = false;
	var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
		entries.forEach(function (entry) {
			if (!entry.isIntersecting || loaded) return;
			loaded = true;
			observer.disconnect();

			container.querySelectorAll('.hero-video[data-src]').forEach(function (v) {
				var src = v.getAttribute('data-src');
				if (src) { v.src = src; v.load(); }
			});

			// Autoplay the initially active mock
			var activeMock = container.querySelector('.hero-video-mock.is-active');
			if (activeMock) {
				setTimeout(function () { playVideo(activeMock); }, 80);
			}
		});
	}, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -5% 0px' });

	observer.observe(container);

	// ── Click handler
	tabs.forEach(function (tab) {
		tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
			var target = tab.dataset.tab;
			if (TABS_DATA.indexOf(target) === -1) return;
			setActiveTab(target);
		});
	});
}());
</script>

<script type="rocketlazyloadscript" data-rocket-type="text/javascript">
	// Videos autoplay id="view-port"

	function playPauseVideo() {
		let videos = document.querySelectorAll("#view-port");
		videos.forEach((video) => {

			video.muted = true;

			let playPromise = video.play();
			if (playPromise !== undefined) {
				playPromise.then((_) => {
					let observer = new IntersectionObserver(
						(entries) => {
							entries.forEach((entry) => {
								if (
									entry.intersectionRatio !== 1 &&
									!video.paused
								) {
									video.pause();
								} else if (video.paused) {
									video.play();
								}
							});
						}, {
							threshold: 0.2
						}
					);
					observer.observe(video);
				});
			}
		});
	}


	playPauseVideo();
</script>

<script type="rocketlazyloadscript" data-rocket-type="module">
	(async () => {
		const w        = window.innerWidth;
		const isMobile = w < 820;

		// ── Mobile: image is plain HTML outside #wp-hero-animation, always visible ──
		if (isMobile) {
			return; // hero-animation.js, .css, light.webp, Noise.avif — none downloaded
		}

		// ── Desktop / tablet: inject CSS then mount animation ─────────────────
		// CSS is injected here (not in <head>) so mobile never downloads it.
		await new Promise((resolve) => {
			const link  = document.createElement('link');
			link.rel    = 'stylesheet';
			link.href   = 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/themes/userpilot-inc/assets/hero/hero-animation.css';
			link.onload = resolve;
			link.onerror = resolve; // don't hang if it 404s
			document.head.appendChild(link);
		});

		const { mountHeroAnimation } = await import('https://userpilot.com/wp-content/themes/userpilot-inc/assets/hero/hero-animation.js');

		const isTablet     = w >= 820  && w < 1200;
		const isMidDesktop = w >= 1200 && w < 1600;

		// v2: intro expand (autoplayExpand) and scroll expand are now separate hooks.
		// scrollExpandScale:1 + scrollExpandCoverOpacity:0 are the v2 defaults.
		const noScrollReact = {
			scrollExpandScale:        1,
			scrollExpandCoverOpacity: 0,
		};

		const initialState = isTablet ? {
			ellipseY:    26,
			lightY:      24,
			lightSize:   120,
			lightScaleX: 2,
			...noScrollReact,
		} : isMidDesktop ? {
			ellipseY: 4,
			lightY:   3,
			...noScrollReact,
		} : {
			...noScrollReact, // ≥1600 — original values
		};

		const anim = mountHeroAnimation('#wp-hero-animation', {
			lightImageUrl:  'https://userpilot-website-assets.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/27110632/layer-blur-fff.webp',
			noiseImageUrl:  'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/themes/userpilot-inc/assets/hero/Noise.avif',
			noiseMode:      'auto',
			noiseSpriteUrl: 'https://userpilot.com/wp-content/themes/userpilot-inc/assets/hero/Noise-tile.png',
			initialState,
		});

		// Pause rAF loop when hero scrolls fully out of viewport
		const heroEl = document.getElementById('wp-hero-animation');
		if (heroEl && anim && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
			new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
				anim.setPaused(!entries[0].isIntersecting);
			}, { threshold: 0 }).observe(heroEl);
		}

		// Reveal the animation after it has had one full cycle to settle.
		// The container starts at opacity:0 (see _home.scss) so the initial
		// synchronous render + async image-load re-render are both hidden.
		// 100 ms is enough for requestAnimationFrame to fire once or twice
		// and for the light.webp / Noise.avif loads to complete in cache.
		setTimeout(() => {
			if (heroEl) heroEl.classList.add('is-mounted');
		}, 100);
	})();
</script>
